description: This PHP source file defines a class Migration_546 that handles migration of preferences and configuration settings for the Revive Adserver project, including mapping old preferences to new configuration sections, writing configuration files, and migrating preferences for admin and agency accounts.

classes.name: Migration_546
classes.description: A class that manages the migration of preferences and configuration settings from old formats to new formats during an upgrade process in Revive Adserver.

methods.name: migratePreferences
methods.description: Coordinates the migration process: retrieves default preferences, sets table names, fetches old preferences, filters deprecated ones, maps old preferences to settings and application variables, writes new config, and migrates preferences for admin and agency accounts.

methods.name: _getOldPreferencesAdmin
methods.description: Retrieves the old preferences for the admin account from the database.

methods.name: _getOldPreferences
methods.description: Fetches old preferences from the database, optionally limited to the admin user.

methods.name: _filterOutDeprecatedPreferences
methods.description: Removes deprecated preference entries from the preferences array.

methods.name: _mapOldPrefsToSettings
methods.description: Maps old preference values to new configuration sections and keys, storing them in $aConfNew.

methods.name: _writeSettings
methods.description: Writes the new configuration settings to a config file using OA_Upgrade_Config.

methods.name: _moveAppVars
methods.description: Migrates specific preferences into application variables stored in the database.

methods.name: _insertApplicationVariable
methods.description: Inserts a new application variable record into the database.

methods.name: _mapOldPrefsToPrefs
methods.description: Prepares the preference map for an account by aligning old preferences with new preference structure, including handling GUI column preferences.

methods.name: _movePreferencesAdmin
methods.description: Migrates preferences for the admin account into the new preference system.

methods.name: _insertPreferencesAdmin
methods.description: Inserts preferences for the admin account into the database, creating preference records if necessary.

methods.name: _getPreferencesId
methods.description: Retrieves the preference ID for a given preference name.

methods.name: _insertPreferencesRecord
methods.description: Creates a new preference record in the preferences table.

methods.name: _insertAccountPreferencesAssoc
methods.description: Associates a preference value with an account in the database.

methods.name: _movePreferencesAgency
methods.description: Migrates agency-specific preferences into the new system, associating them with accounts.

methods.name: _getDefaultPreferences
methods.description: Returns default preferences for various account types.
